blocks.title: Happy 4/20 · the best day to drink a hemp seltzer in California
blocks.dek: It's April 20, 2026 — a Monday, clear and 64°F in El Segundo. Six months before the Farm Bill redefinition closes the hemp-THC shelf for most product shapes, and beverage is the form that survives. Good Feels has a special running. This is a note about the day, the moment, and why it's a very good time to pour one.
